plan.understanding: Add one centered annular rope-attachment lug tangent to the exposed vertical end surface of the whistle’s enlarged head, with a 40 mm outer diameter, 20 mm through-hole, and 30 mm thickness.

subtasks.goal: On the single solid, add a circular annular lug tangent to vertical planar face #32 (x=0 mm, center [0,260,-380] mm) of the enlarged head: set the lug axis parallel to that face along world Z, outer diameter 40 mm, concentric through-hole diameter 20 mm, and axial thickness 30 mm spanning z=-395 to -365 mm. Center its axis at [x=-20,y=260,*] mm so the outer cylinder is tangent to face #32 at x=0 and the lug is centered on that face in Y and Z; unite the attachment with the existing body at the specified contact. The resulting lug must reach x=-40 mm without changing the Y or Z envelope. Print the achieved axis, center, diameters, axial endpoints, tangency coordinate, and resulting body count, and correct them in the same attempt if they differ from these targets.
